purpose: Account and app settings: titled sections of settings, optional settings navigation, and the danger zone last.

props.name: variant
props.description: single (default) or with-nav for a settings navigation column

props.name: nav
props.description: with-nav only: SideNav or Tabs listing settings areas

props.name: children
props.description: The settings, one Section per topic

props.name: dangerZone
props.description: A danger Section for destructive actions; always rendered last

whenToUse: Profile, notification, security and billing settings
whenNotToUse: A single form with one submit — use FormPage
antiPatterns: Destructive actions outside the danger zone
One long section mixing unrelated settings

sizes: Container md or lg; the nav keeps its own width; sections at least `size-container-sm` before they wrap; gaps `space-layout-section`, `space-component-padding-lg`

a11yNotes: The danger zone is last in source order, after every other setting

slots.name: nav
slots.description: with-nav only. One entry per settings area.

slots.name: sections
slots.description: One titled Section per topic, such as Profile or Notifications. Switches for on/off settings; each change says when it takes effect.

slots.name: dangerZone
slots.description: A danger Section titled for the action, such as Delete account, with one sentence on the consequence and a danger button that opens a confirmation Modal.
